  -- storageRootWriteStore, storageRootWriteValueRhsCapture

  -- storageRootWriteCopySource
  | _, .root r h, .copy (.alias j) hm => .save (.root r h) (.copy (.alias j) hm)
  -- storageRootWriteCopySource, storageFieldReadStoreRoot,

    let done := .save (.root r h) (.copy (.loc l) hm)
    (SHole.copy (.root r h) hm).readStep k (fun _ _ => done) (fun _ _ _ => done) (fun _ _ _ => done) l
  | _, .field b f h, .val e =>

def Stmt.step (k : Nat) (m : Modality) {Γ Γ' : Ctx} (s : Stmt C Γ Γ') : Premise C Γ Γ' :=
  Stmt.casesOn (motive_1 := fun Γ Γ' _ => Premise C Γ Γ') s
    (assign := fun l r => assignStep k l r)
    (rebind := fun i r => rebindStep k i r)
    (assignLocal := fun i v => localStep k i v)
    -- valueDeclSkip, localValueDeclInitDrop
    (declLocal := fun p x init => match init with
      | none => .update (Upd.nil.decl x (.val (.app0 (.lit (PrimTy.dflt p)))))
      | some e => .bind x (.val p) (.cons (.assignLocal .here e.up) .nil))
    -- storageLocalDeclSkip, storageLocalDeclInitDrop
    (declStorage := fun R x init => match init with
      | none => .update (Upd.nil.decl (t := .alias R) x .unset)
      | some r => .bind x (.alias R) (.cons (.rebind .here r.up) .nil))
    (opAssign := fun op hop hp l r => opStep k op hop hp l r)
    (incDec := fun op hp l => incStep k op hp l)
    (assignIncDec := fun i op hp l _ => assignIncStep i op hp l)
    (assignLocalPush := fun i b => assignLocalPushStep k i b)
    (push := fun b v hd => pushStep k b v hd) (pop := fun b => popStep k b)
    (transfer := fun r a => transferStep k m r a) (send := fun pv r a g => sendStep k m pv g r a)
    -- memoryReferenceDeclFreshAlloc, memoryLocalDeclInitDrop
    (declMem := fun R x init _ hm => match init with
      | none => .update ((Upd.nil.decl x (.mref (.app1 (.alloc R hm) (.app0 .memory)))).snoc
          (.memory (.app1 (.addM R hm) (.app0 .memory))))
      | some r => .bind x (.mem R) (.cons (.rebindMem .here r.up) .nil))
    (rebindMem := fun i r => rebindMemStep k i r)
    (assignFromMem := fun l p => assignFromMemStep k l p)
    (assignMem := fun l r => assignMemStep k l r)
    (delete := fun l => deleteStep k l)
    (deleteMem := fun p hd => deleteMemStep k p hd)
    (assignNew := fun l n h => assignNewStep k l n h)
    (ite := fun c thn els => iteStep k c thn els)
    (require := fun c => requireStep k c)
    (assert := fun c => assertStep k c)
    -- revertBox, revertDiamond
    (revert := match m with
      | .box => .done true
      | .diamond => .done false)
    -- assumeFalse (Lean)
    (assumeFalse := .done true)
    (call := fun f args ret body => callStep k f args ret body)
    (tryCall := fun call rets ok err code pnc other sargs sbody self =>
      tryStepS m call rets ok err code pnc other sargs sbody self)
    (loop := fun a c body => loopStep k m a c body)
    -- a block is its statements, its locals popped after it
    (block := fun body => .unfold body body.ext)
    (pushOpAssign := fun op hop hp b r => pushOpStep k op hop hp b r)
    (pushIncDec := fun op hp b => pushIncStep k op hp b)
    (callReceiver := fun f args r body op => callReceiverStep k f args r body op)
    (callReceiverPush := fun f args r body code value =>
      ReceiverValue.step k f args r body (.deferred code value))
    -- recursiveCallUnfold (Lean only): the call of its body
    (callRec := fun f _ args ret body => .unfold (.cons (.call f args ret (body ())) .nil) .refl)
    -- revertDataBox, revertDataDiamond (Lean)
    (revertData := fun _ => match m with
      | .box => .done true
      | .diamond => .done false)
    -- catchDataBox, catchDataDiamond (Lean)
    (catchData := fun call _ _ sbody self kind x body => catchDataStep m call sbody self kind x body)

def pushStep {E : Ty} (b : SPath C Γ (.array E)) (v : Option (Src C Γ E))
    (hd : (v.isSome || E.defaultOkS) = true) : Premise C Γ Γ :=
  if b.isSimple then
    match E, b, v with
    | E, b, none =>
      -- storagePushLengthSave
      if b.elemPrim then .upd1 (UpdElem.pushSlot b)
      -- Every element is kept as it is: the push saves only the length.
      else if b.elemMapping then .upd1 (UpdElem.extend b)
      else .upd1 (UpdElem.pushSlot b)
    -- storagePushValueSave
    | _, b, some (.val (.simple se)) =>
      .upd1 (UpdElem.push b (.val (.simple se)))
    -- storagePushValue_unfold_rightSndArgument
    | _, b, some (.val e) =>
      .capture _ (if e.complexStorageRead then .fresh "source" k else fse k) e
        (.push b.up (some (.val (.simple (.local .here)))) rfl)
    -- storagePushValueCopySource
    | _, b, some (.copy p hm) =>
      if p.isSimple then .upd1 (UpdElem.push b (.copy p hm))
      else .captureSP (.fresh "source" k) p
        (.push b.up (some (.copy (.alias .here) hm)) rfl)
    | _, b, some (.copyMem p) =>
      if p.isSimple then .upd1 (UpdElem.push b (.copyMem p))
      else .captureMV (fmv k) p
        (.push b.up (some (.copyMem (.var .here p.mapFree))) rfl)
    | _, b, some (.fixedCopy p shape hm) => .upd1 (UpdElem.push b (.fixedCopy p shape hm))
    | _, b, some (.fixedCopyMem p shape) => .upd1 (UpdElem.push b (.fixedCopyMem p shape))
  -- storagePush_unfold_leftFstReceiver, storagePushValue_unfold_leftFstReceiver
  else .captureSP (fsp k) b (.push (.alias .here) (v.map Src.up) (by
    cases v <;> exact hd))

def Stmt.step (k : Nat) (m : Modality) {Γ Γ' : Ctx} (s : Stmt C Γ Γ') : Premise C Γ Γ' :=
  Stmt.casesOn (motive_1 := fun Γ Γ' _ => Premise C Γ Γ') s
    (assign := fun l r => assignStep k l r)
    (rebind := fun i r => rebindStep k i r)
    (assignLocal := fun i v => localStep k i v)
    -- valueDeclSkip, localValueDeclInitDrop
    (declLocal := fun p x init => match init with
      | none => .update (Upd.nil.decl x (.val (.app0 (.lit (PrimTy.dflt p)))))
      | some e => .bind x (.val p) (.cons (.assignLocal .here e.up) .nil))
    -- storageLocalDeclSkip, storageLocalDeclInitDrop
    (declStorage := fun R x init => match init with
      | none => .update (Upd.nil.decl (t := .alias R) x .unset)
      | some r => .bind x (.alias R) (.cons (.rebind .here r.up) .nil))
    (opAssign := fun op hop hp l r => opStep k op hop hp l r)
    (incDec := fun op hp l => incStep k op hp l)
    (assignIncDec := fun i op hp l _ => assignIncStep i op hp l)
    (assignLocalPush := fun i b => assignLocalPushStep k i b)
    (push := fun b v hd => pushStep k b v hd) (pop := fun b => popStep k b)
    (transfer := fun r a => transferStep k m r a) (send := fun pv r a g => sendStep k m pv g r a)
    -- memoryReferenceDeclFreshAlloc, memoryLocalDeclInitDrop
    (declMem := fun R x init _ hm => match init with
      | none => .update ((Upd.nil.decl x (.mref (.app1 (.alloc R hm) (.app0 .memory)))).snoc
          (.memory (.app1 (.addM R hm) (.app0 .memory))))
      | some r => .bind x (.mem R) (.cons (.rebindMem .here r.up) .nil))
    (rebindMem := fun i r => rebindMemStep k i r)
    (assignFromMem := fun l p => assignFromMemStep k l p)
    (assignMem := fun l r => assignMemStep k l r)
    (delete := fun l => deleteStep k l)
    (deleteMem := fun p hd => deleteMemStep k p hd)
    (assignNew := fun l n h => assignNewStep k l n h)
    (ite := fun c thn els => iteStep k c thn els)
    (require := fun c => requireStep k c)
    (assert := fun c => assertStep k c)
    -- revertBox, revertDiamond
    (revert := match m with
      | .box => .done true
      | .diamond => .done false)
    -- assumeFalse (Lean)
    (assumeFalse := .done true)
    (call := fun f args ret body => callStep k f args ret body)
    (tryCall := fun call rets ok err code pnc other sargs sbody self =>
      tryStepS m call rets ok err code pnc other sargs sbody self)
    (loop := fun a c body => loopStep k m a c body)
    -- a block is its statements, its locals popped after it
    (block := fun body => .unfold body body.ext)
    (pushOpAssign := fun op hop hp b r => pushOpStep k op hop hp b r)
    (pushIncDec := fun op hp b => pushIncStep k op hp b)
    (callReceiver := fun f args r body op => callReceiverStep k f args r body op)
    (callReceiverPush := fun f args r body code value =>
      ReceiverValue.step k f args r body (.deferred code value))
    -- recursiveCallUnfold (Lean only): the call of its body
    (callRec := fun f _ args ret body => .unfold (.cons (.call f args ret (body ())) .nil) .refl)
    -- revertDataBox, revertDataDiamond (Lean)
    (revertData := fun _ => match m with
      | .box => .done true
      | .diamond => .done false)
    -- catchDataBox, catchDataDiamond (Lean)
    (catchData := fun call _ _ sbody self kind x body => catchDataStep m call sbody self kind x body)

def callStep (k : Nat) {Γ' ps rs Γf : Ctx} (f : Name) (args : Args C Γ ps) (ret : CallRet Γ rs Γ')
    (body : Prog C (rs ++ ps) Γf) : Premise C Γ Γ' :=
  CallRet.casesOn (motive := fun rs Γ' _ => Prog C (rs ++ ps) Γf → Premise C Γ Γ') ret
    (fun body => match args.capture with
      | some ⟨p, v, as'⟩ => .capture p (fse k) v (.call f as' .none body)
      | none => .unfold (args.declsThen
          (.cons (.block (body.wk (Thin.atop ps Γ)).2.2) .nil)) (Ext.append Γ ps))
    (fun p r res body => match args.capture with
      | some ⟨p', v, as'⟩ => .capture p' (fse k) v (.call f as' (.val p r (res.map .there)) body)
      | none => match CallRet.summary? args (.val p r res) body with
        | some U => .update U
        | none =>
          let result : Prog C (.val p :: (ps ++ Γ)) (.val p :: (ps ++ Γ)) := match res with
            | none => .nil
            | some j => .cons (.assignLocal (j.under ps).there (.simple (.local .here))) .nil
          .unfold (args.declsThen (.cons (.declLocal p r none)
            (.cons (.block (body.wk (Thin.atop (.val p :: ps) Γ)).2.2) result)))
            (.push (Ext.append Γ ps)))
    (fun {rs} bs body => match args.capture with
      | some ⟨p', v, as'⟩ => .inline
          (.cons (.declLocal p' (fse k) (some v)) (.cons (.call f as' (.rets bs) body) .nil))
          (Thin.keepAll rs (.drop .refl))
      | none => .inline (args.declsThen (bs.declsThen
          (.cons (.block (body.wk (Thin.keepAll rs (Thin.atop ps Γ))).2.2) .nil)))
          (Thin.keepAll rs (Thin.ofExt (Ext.append Γ ps))))
    (fun R r hd hm body => match args.capture with
      | some ⟨p', v, as'⟩ => .inline
          (.cons (.declLocal p' (fse k) (some v)) (.cons (.call f as' (.mem R r hd hm) body) .nil))
          (.keep (.drop .refl))
      | none => .inline (args.declsThen (.cons (.declMem R r none hd hm)
          (.cons (.block (body.wk (Thin.atop (.mem R :: ps) Γ)).2.2) .nil)))
          (.keep (Thin.ofExt (Ext.append Γ ps))))
    (fun R r body => match args.capture with
      | some ⟨p', v, as'⟩ => .inline
          (.cons (.declLocal p' (fse k) (some v)) (.cons (.call f as' (.storage R r) body) .nil))

      | none => .inline (args.declsThen (.cons (.declStorage R r none)
